integrity: Reproducible exact prime enumeration and proof using additive prime-power weights; scientific claim reviewed but not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Only bases 2, 3, 4 and 5; the base-general existence problem remains open. Finite checks establish exceptional small-prime cases only, not the infinite argument. External independent validation and publication priority are not established.
title: No prime \(v\)-palindromes in the first four positional bases
